prompt:
A single 2D pixel art sprite sheet for a top-down racing game. Sharp crisp pixel art, hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, retro 16-bit palette. TRUE FULLY TRANSPARENT background (alpha = 0) behind and between every sprite. NO checkerboard painted into the image, NO grey squares, NO solid fill. Sprites laid out in a clean evenly spaced grid with wide transparent gaps between them for auto-slicing.

Render EXACTLY these items grouped into rows, and NOTHING ELSE:

ROW 1: two BLUE race cars, strict top-down bird's-eye view, nose pointing UP (2 frames).
ROW 2: player explosion frames 1-5 — tiny white blast growing into a bigger orange fireball.
ROW 3: player explosion frames 6-10 — massive peak orange fireball, then collapsing into dark smoke, ending as a small black charred burnt wreckage.
ROW 4: two RED race cars, strict top-down view, nose pointing UP (2 frames).
ROW 5: two WHITE/GREY desaturated race cars, top-down view, nose UP — blinking (frame 1 bright, frame 2 dim/faded).
ROW 6: a plain BLANK YELLOW flag on a pole, 4 wavy waving frames.
ROW 7: a YELLOW flag with a bold RED letter 'S' on it, 4 wavy waving frames.
ROW 8: a YELLOW flag with a bold RED letter 'L' on it, 4 wavy waving frames.
ROW 9: a grey smoke cloud, 6 frames — small puff, growing to a big thick cloud, then thinning and fading to wisps.

STRICT RULES — this is critical:
- Include ALL nine rows. Do not stop early. Rows 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 (stunned cars, all three flags, smoke) MUST be present and clearly drawn.
- Do NOT add any other objects. FORBIDDEN: no power-ups, no shields, no rockets, no lightning bolts, no traffic cones, no barricades, no oil slicks, no coins, no checkered flags, no speedometer, no HUD, no title screen, no banners.
- Do NOT write any text, labels, numbers, captions, or watermarks anywhere. The ONLY text allowed in the entire image is the red 'S' on the row 7 flags and the red 'L' on the row 8 flags. No 'GO', no 'LAP', no 'GAME OVER', no '1UP', no title.
